kjv: Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag
mine: Nergal-sharezer of Samgar, Nebu-sarsekim the Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer the Rab-mag
note: Rab-saris ("chief official") and Rab-mag (a high Babylonian office) are titles, not names; a Babylonian tablet names one Nabu-sharrussu-ukin as rab sha-reshi, matching "Nebu-sarsekim the Rab-saris". The KJV lists six persons.
